aka: Die gefährliche Reise der Sardinen – Festmahl im Ozean
Sardine Run, le plus grand festin de l'océan
南アフリカの海 海の大スペクタクル“サーディン・ラン”を追う
description:
At the start of every winter, the coast of South Africa sees billions of little sardines converge in the biggest biomass migration on the planet. Alone, a sardine is insignificant and vulnerable. Together they are a formidable force that feeds an entire coastline. It is a strange decision… The sardines ride a cold current - against all odds of survival, and the purpose is largely a mystery. The shoal runs an epic gauntlet. They must pass an ancient seal colony, a lethal aerial assault by gannets and thousands of hungry sharks. But it’s when dolphins arrive that the feast really begins! Everything tips in favor of the predators, until Orcas arrive.
A production of Earth Touch, The WNET Group and Bonne Pioche Television in association with Love Nature, SVT, France Télévisions and NHK.
